impact: For a fresh Gemini review A, agy writes conversation A to the cwd-keyed cache; an independent bridge/agy process B using the same cwd then writes conversation B before A reads the cache. A returns its own review paired with B's session_id, so a subsequent resume targets another conversation. I read runAgyPrint, runAgyReview, runSerialized, and the lifecycle freshness checks: serialization is process-local, and freshness only rejects an already-known ID, so an external B ID absent from this bridge registry/database passes. The stream-json result already carries the per-invocation conversation_id but runAgyPrint discards it. This is the existing ISS-037, not a newly discovered issue.
resolution: Duplicate of existing ISS-037, automatically filed by lens synthesis. The confirmed shared-cache conversation-ID race remains tracked in ISS-037; no production fix claimed here.
